name: Standard Model Concordance

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Action Integral S over all spacetime manifolds

VINIT.justification: The zero-point field configuration before the introduction of specific particle excitations or gauge interactions.

TANCH.justification: The complete mathematical boundary that contains all permissible interactions and field definitions within the theory.

AFWD.justification: The forward transformation from a high-energy symmetric state to a lower-energy state with mass generation via the Higgs mechanism.

AREV.justification: The reverse mapping of coupling constants from high energy scales back to observable low energy parameters.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of local operators to describe complex interaction vertices in quantum field theory.

IMSCRIB.justification: The identity transformation where the physics remains unchanged under local phase rotations of the fields.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the unified SU(2) x U(1) symmetry into distinct electromagnetic and weak force sectors.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the electromagnetic and weak sectors into a single unified gauge theory at high energy scales.

EVALT.justification: A physical state that satisfies the relativistic energy-momentum relation.

EVALF.justification: An off-shell state that exists only within internal propagator lines and cannot be directly observed.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous manifestation of discrete quanta and continuous field wave properties without resolution into a single classical category.

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of a physical constant value into the empirical record through experimental observation.

phase_3.void_description: The pre-inflationary state where no field excitations or gauge structures are defined.
phase_3.true_description: A stable particle configuration that satisfies all conservation laws and gauge constraints.
phase_3.false_description: A forbidden transition or anomaly that violates the internal consistency of the gauge group.
phase_3.both_description: A quantum superposition where multiple mutually exclusive field configurations exist simultaneously.

steps.domain_action: Establish the underlying Hilbert space and vacuum expectation value.
Define the global SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1) gauge symmetry group.
Record the fundamental coupling constants as fixed parameters of the theory.
Branch the unified field into fermionic matter and bosonic force carriers.
Apply the Higgs field potential to trigger spontaneous symmetry breaking.
Confirm the generation of mass for the W and Z bosons.
Recombine the mass-eigenstates into the complete electroweak sector.
Chain the strong interaction vertices to the electroweak framework.
Separate the quark sector into distinct flavor generations.
Map the CKM matrix elements to determine flavor mixing angles.
Identify suppressed transitions that violate CP symmetry.
Reconstitute the flavor sector into the total hadronic Lagrangian.
Hold the asymptotic freedom and infrared slavery of QCD in simultaneous tension.
Compose the full interaction Hamiltonian from all field sectors.
Verify the Ward-Takahashi identities for the complete system.
Append the calculated cross-sections to the permanent physical record.
Seal the system within the total action integral of the Standard Model.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Path Integral Formulation which translates field interactions into probability amplitudes.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Gauge Boson exchange mediating forces between fermionic matter fields.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The vacuum state and the values of the 19 fundamental constants of nature.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The principle of least action determining the evolution of field configurations.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Particle Data Group (PDG) database of experimental measurements and theoretical averages.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The energy density required to excite a field from the vacuum state.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A state of high-energy symmetry with massless particles.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A state of broken symmetry with massive particles and residual gauge interactions.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The unitary evolution of the quantum state preserves information and total probability.
